item.title: Top GOP defense voice breaks with invasion fears, says US can reopen Hormuz without ground war
item.summary: Rep. Mike Turner says he doesn't think U.S. ground troops will be necessary to open the Strait of Hormuz amid Trump's escalating threats to Iran.

item.title: NPR public editor admits glaring absence of Jewish victim's voices in coverage of Michigan synagogue attack
item.summary: The NPR public editor admitted important Jewish voices were missing from coverage of the March attack on Temple Israel synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan.

item.title: Iran executes people, including teens, by hanging
item.summary: The nation of Iran has been carrying out executions, including of teenagers, as the U.S. and Israel wage war against the country, reports indicate.

item.title: Trump reveals Iran made 'significant proposal' after ultimatum, but 'not good enough'
item.summary: Trump tells reporters at the White House Easter Egg Roll that Iran made a significant proposal but says it is not good enough amid ongoing strikes.

item.title: WNBA champ Natasha Cloud takes issue with Trump's Iran message on Easter
item.summary: New York Liberty guard Natasha Cloud slammed President Donald Trump for his Easter Sunday warning to Iran, saying a president threatening to bomb "is not a man of Christ."

item.title: American tourists warned of arrest, jail time for taking photos, pocketing souvenirs in locale
item.summary: The U.S. State Department updated its Ethiopia travel advisory, warning American travelers of unrest, strict currency rules, photography bans and $3,000 exit fees.

item.title: Left-wing toolkit from college professors group urges students to ‘create a crisis’ over ICE
item.summary: Left-wing groups, including one representing colleg professors, produced a student toolkit encouraging campaigns against ICE by targeting corporate contracts at hundreds of colleges.

item.title: 'Full House' star Dave Coulier warns 'everything in my life was toxic' before cancer battle
item.summary: "Full House" star Dave Coulier opens up about replacing toxic everyday products after surviving two cancer diagnoses, inspiring his new venture Awear Market.

item.title: Rescue expert says most dangerous moment comes after ‘jackpot’ call in recovery behind enemy lines
item.summary: A veteran rescue expert reacts to the U.S. airman rescue in Iran, explaining why getting home after securing the objective is often the most dangerous part.

item.title: Amazon job text scam warning signs
item.summary: Fraudsters are using texts offering jobs to target phones, often posing as Amazon with suspicious contact details and no hiring process.
